clusters.name: codex-rebase-0140-serial
clusters.executionModeRationale: A codex upstream rebase is a single serial dependency chain operating on ONE submodule worktree: squash-merge rust-v0.140.0, resolve conflicts, converge cargo check --workspace to zero, run audits, cut the release, close out. Every story mutates the same working tree and the same sandbox-patches branch tip, so parallel execution would corrupt the merge state. Serialize unconditionally. The only valid parallelism is filing independent codex-rebase-debt-fix-* sub-tasks AFTER the squash, each scoped to a disjoint crate, but those are still resolved sequentially in the same worktree.
